sv.title: Pojke fritagen av polis – sex anhållna
sv.summary: En pojke som fördes bort mot sin vilja i Karlskoga under fredagen har fritagits av polisen. Sex personer har anhållits. – Brottet har rubricerats som människorov, säger polisens operativa chef Johanna Björk till NWT.

en.title: Boy freed by police – six detained
en.summary: A boy who was taken against his will in Karlskoga on Friday has been freed by police. Six people have been detained. – The crime has been classified as kidnapping, police operational chief Johanna Björk tells NWT.
